title: Prayer Metric0 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prayer:metric0 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for prayer metric0 data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for prayer metric0 events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It works out the smoothed week-long trend in your value from prayer metric0.
